title: PrestaShop Conversion
meta: Product page, cart and checkout improvements for your PrestaShop store, built to turn more visitors into buyers. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Turn more PrestaShop visitors into paying customers
overview: We walk through your PrestaShop store as a shopper and note every place someone might hesitate. Then we fix them: clearer product pages, visible delivery and returns information, a simpler cart, fewer checkout fields and trust signals near the pay button. We set up tracking so you can see the effect, and send you a plain list of every change with the reason behind it.

faq: No. We improve clarity and remove friction using well known store practices, and set up tracking so you can measure the change. Results depend on traffic and your offer.
Do you replace my checkout module?
Only if it is the cause of a problem. Often we simplify the one you have. If a replacement is better, we explain why and quote it before changing anything.
Will changes affect my current orders?
No. We work on a duplicate store, test the full buying flow, and only then apply changes to the live shop at a quiet time.
Premium includes a test plan you can run with a testing tool. Running tests over weeks is outside a seven day project, so we prepare and hand them over.
